title: 2007 National Press Club event with international officials

tellings.quote: closer to 3we Expedition and Leslie and I were putting on this event at the

plain: In 2007 a UFO investigator named James Fox and the journalist Leslie Kean put on an event at the National Press Club in Washington, where officials from several countries, among them Parviz Jafari, spoke about UFOs. Fox tells Michels he organized it with Kean, though what he says about it here is brief. They held it so that officials, not just enthusiasts, would put their own accounts on the public record.
